CustomField.description: When the guest's post-trip feedback arrived: the latest Feedback_Response__c.Submitted_On__c. Calculated by Salesforce (roll-up), so it fills in the moment the survey is submitted and clears if the response is deleted. Once the invitation has gone out (SurveySent__c), empty means not answered yet. The answer that fills it also moves the booking status to Feedback, and the validation rule Gx_Feedback_Only_After_Answer keeps Feedback for answered bookings.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Wann das Feedback des Gastes eingegangen ist. Wird automatisch gesetzt, sobald der Gast die Umfrage absendet. Leer bedeutet: noch keine Antwort.
